title: Customers who bought both Widget and Gadget
prompt: Return the customer_name (column: customer_name) of customers who have purchased both 'Widget' and 'Gadget', using INTERSECT between two subqueries on the purchases table.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE purchases (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_name TEXT, product TEXT); INSERT INTO purchases VALUES (1,'Farah Kline','Widget'),(2,'Farah Kline','Gadget'),(3,'Gus Palmer','Widget'),(4,'Gus Palmer','Sprocket'),(5,'Hana Osei','Gadget'),(6,'Ira Delgado','Widget'),(7,'Ira Delgado','Gadget'),(8,'Jill Stone','Sprocket');
reference_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM purchases WHERE product = 'Widget' INTERSECT SELECT customer_name FROM purchases WHERE product = 'Gadget';
